items.detail: Questionable (right knee soreness) on the second night of a back-to-back after playing Tuesday vs SAS; still questionable on the 5:00 PM ET official report and his status will be decided near tipoff, with Rotoworld suggesting it may be a maintenance-type absence.
Not on the injury report; if Cunningham sits the second half of the back-to-back, Jenkins is the expected beneficiary of extra ball-handling and playmaking, which supports today's assists Best Bet.

note: Evening run: 5:00 PM ET official report matches the brief; Cade Cunningham's back-to-back knee decision is the only open question touching a Best Bet. Rotoworld reported RJ Barrett out, but the 5:00 PM official report still lists him questionable, so no item.
